children: RMX Industries amended its senior secured convertible note to extend the maturity of a $2.02 million 15% note. The new maturity is Dec 31, 2026, with an automatic extension to Mar 31, 2027 if the company uplists its common stock to an eligible national exchange before year-end 2026. The note remains convertible into Class A common stock under existing terms. The extension is intended to provide additional liquidity and flexibility as the company pursues an exchange uplisting.
: Amendment extending maturity of senior secured convertible note (15% interest)
: Through Dec 31 2026; to Mar 31 2027 upon uplisting
: Extend debt maturity and preserve liquidity
